maya_net: spotting p99 tail spikes on eu-north hosts, NIC tx queue 2 saturating, small-packet floods from a handful of tenants. GPUs idle.
leo_sched: sounds like tokenized RPC noisy neighbors. any top talkers?
maya_net: tenant-playback (48%), tenant-quicktest (21%), internal-sync (12%). bursts are short but frequent, causing irq storms.
arya_sre: quick mitigation: create a microshard slice with per-host eBPF pacing and soft-route noisy tenants there. keep it preemptible to avoid reserved spend.
leo_sched: agree. plan: 10% soft-redirect -> 40% -> 80% with 10m windows, add eBPF probe and billing tag.
maya_net: commands: kubectl annotate tenant tenant-playback routing=microshard-nic-fair; curl scheduler api set weight 0.1 region=eu-north slice=microshard-nic-fair
opsbot: Incident INC-2026-6120 created "eu-north nic microshard" with paging p99>250ms 10m.
financebot: cost tracker enabled; preemptible slice keeps delta low.
arya_sre: if p99 improves >30% promote, else rollback and consider proxy token-bucket. will write runbook."
